primary_benefit: geometry and size under a calibrated microscopy-SEM correspondence, or a separately declared real measurement benefit; never sharpness alone

fixed_comparison.early_checkpoints: diagnostic development only unless a common selection rule is frozen before all outputs

geometry.intended_primary: common-coordinate SEM boundary distance after independent readout qualification
geometry.until_mapping_qualified: ACM and half-contrast are noninterchangeable observations; contradictory directions mean unresolved, not success
geometry.legacy_and_pitch_matched_references: both retained as current sensitivity conditions, not alternative scores to choose after results
geometry.steepest_point: fixed settings with ambiguity and common coverage; never rescue an invalid primary population by dropping Raw

detail.full_restoration_claim_requires: independent optical reference or independently verified physical structures

application_thresholds.status: unset: exploratory comparisons only; decision-bearing short-run promotion limits must be fixed before first real outputs, not postponed until confirmation

primary_benefit_lock_time: before first decision-bearing real candidate output is observed
ROI_panel_status: Existing sources inventoried. Reuse Raw-selected fixed R68 ROIs when verified; additional SEM/corner/gap masks and eligibility must be frozen from Raw/use case before candidate outputs.
